archetypes.name: wire-fixture-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Review the boundary between canonical fixtures and intentionally malformed grammar tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that shared builders cover valid design wire shapes without normalizing negative fixtures. Verify exact newline, ordering, JSON, heading, and KEY=value behavior across migrated tests. Flag uses of make_design_tmpdir that could change directory-sensitive assertions. Cite file paths and symbols for every finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
